summary: Listed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association only as an unknown, undocumented site in Uintah County; no lookout history found.

evidence.supports: listed under Unknown/Undocumented Sites, not among lookouts
a site moves to the lookout lists if evidence of regular fire-lookout use turns up
evidence.quote: If evidence or documentation is uncovered showing that any of these were actually used as regular wildland fire lookout sites, they will be moved to the lookout lists.

notes_for_editor: The only source found is the association's Utah list, which places Dyer Ridge among unknown and undocumented sites with coordinates and no structure, date, use or staffing. No history, design, height or current condition is documented, so the story is shorter than the usual minimum. Recommend keeping the record hidden or unpublished unless a source shows lookout use. Web searches for Dyer Ridge as a lookout returned nothing specific to this site.
